text:
elaine_cs: Heads-up — prepping Cobalt Labs QBR next Tues. Onboarding ~80% but token burn spiked last week. Need a quick cost readout + enablement asks. Anyone free for a 15m sync?
marcus_se: I can do 15m at 10:30am PT tomorrow. Looked at their dashboard — embeddings are ~60% of tokens because of large batch sizes.
vivian_pm: From product: they recently added autocomplete + semantic search. Value is there but we should show where to trim. Can we prepare a few 'what-if' forecast scenarios for the deck?
gary_finops: I can run 3 scenarios (90/70/50% batching). Also flag: their monthly budget email alert is disabled. Recommend re-enable or set hard throttle. :warning:
elaine_cs: Please run the forecasts and share a TL;DR for the QBR deck. Also capture their feedback about model drift — they reported more hallucinations on long docs.
billing-bot: Automated alert: Cobalt Labs (acct 4321) — projected 30d spend = $18,900 at current runrate. Threshold configured at $15,000 but email alerts are OFF.
marcus_se: Quick wins notes: reduce max_seq 2048 -> 1024 for batch infer, enable prefix KV cache for repeated queries, and switch embeddings to smaller model for near-dupe detection. I'll prototype numbers.
gary_finops: I'll sketch a quick inline summary. Example estimates (ballpark): `current: tokens=20.1M -> $18.9k`, `90% batching -> 14.2M -> $12.9k`, `70% batching -> 11.5M -> $9.8k`. KV cache could add another ~30% token savings depending on query patterns.
vivian_pm: Can we export the last 30-day promptset and create a cost-vs-quality chart? That helps the customer prioritize which prompts to optimize.
elaine_cs: I'll own the deck. @marcus_se please drop numbers + a short config diff into this thread. @gary_finops please re-enable budget email alert and set a soft limit at $14k.
marcus_se: Done — paste of rough numbers & config diffs:
```
current: tokens=20.1M, cost=$18.9k
90% batching: tokens=14.2M, cost=$12.9k
70% batching: tokens=11.5M, cost=$9.8k
kv_cache: estimated -30% tokens when prefix reuse > 40%
config diffs: max_seq 2048->1024, batch_size drop 4x->2x, embed_model: em-small-v2
```
gary_finops: Budget alert updated: email alerts ON, soft_limit=$14,000, hard_throttle=95% of projected daily rate. Also added an action item for CS to confirm KV retention policy with legal.
vivian_pm: Noted on KV retention. For hallucinations I'll create a focused eval on their long-doc set in Optimize and add results to the QBR appendix.
elaine_cs: Great. Next steps: 1) Marcus finalize numbers + config diffs, 2) Gary re-run forecasts with the model-variant costs, 3) Vivian create eval + feedback slide. Sync tomorrow 10:30am PT. :thumbsup:
